products.title: Ice Blue & Brights Travel Mahjong Set
products.body_html: The Mahjong House’s Travel Sets are designed to bring the joy of community, play, and high-quality craftsmanship to your Mahjong House away from home, wherever that may be. Our sets include everything you need to play, anywhere you are, including tiles, racks, a storage bag, and more. The tiles are thin and lightweight, but maintain the surface area and designs of the House Collection tiles you know and love so no game is compromised, even on the go. Plus, never worry about forgetting your NMJL card—we’ve included The House Card x 4, so the game can go on without a hitch. Whether you’re lounging poolside or gathered around a cozy table, the Ice Blue & Brights Travel Mahjong Set delivers vibrant, luxurious play and a sense of escape, wherever life takes you.

products.title: White Mother of Pearl Deco Tiles
products.body_html:
Chic mother-of-pearl-patterned mahjong tiles adorned with delicate, geometric peacocks, dragonflies, and patterns in rich hues are an homage to an era defined by luxury, glamour, and exuberance. The Charleston in American mahjong is named after the wildly popular fast-paced, rhythmic 1920s dance of the same name, forged in an era when mahjong first became popular in the US. The Art Deco movement, like these tiles, marries luxurious materials and exquisite craftsmanship with a joie de vivre ethos akin to a riotously choreographed game of mahjong. Complete the look with our complimentary Deco Collection racks and mats and transform your whole game.

products.title: Set of 4 Clear Mahjong Racks
products.body_html: Elevate your Mahjong game with our clear acrylic magnetic Mahjong Racks—an elegant, modern twist on a must-have playing tool. Crafted from lightweight acrylic, these racks are durable, easy to handle, and fit walls of up to 20 tiles, making them perfect for any game. They blend seamlessly with any decor, adding a touch of sophistication to your game table. The magnetic pusher adds to the versatility too. These are clear, so they go with literally any tiles or mats, so let's play!

products.title: Blue Double-Sided Mahjong Mat
products.body_html:
Bring double the elegance to your game with our brand new reversible mahjong mat. That's two beautiful mats in one! One side features a delicate peony design in blues on a light purple field. The other side is our Mahjong House flower border in navy on a light blue field. This mat creates a stunning backdrop, especially to any tiles in our House Collection, adding warmth and charm to every game. Mats at The Mahjong House are designed to make each hand feel as special as the last.

Materials: Spandex & Rubber; Machine Washable: Dimensions: 31.5" x 31.5"
